name: Backblaze64
description: Backblaze Personal Backup running under Wine (64-bit Windows environment) on Ubuntu 24.04. Provides a web-based GUI via browser or VNC, and keeps Backblaze updated to the latest version on each restart. Includes a live upload dashboard (bb-monitor, run from the container console), backup-aware health status on this Docker page, optional automatic recovery from stalled backups, and built-in diagnostic tools (bb-doctor, bb-report, bb-version). Note on the beta tag: the :beta image carries two patches to Wine's socket code that are not in the stable images. One is submitted upstream. The other is a workaround that deliberately differs from how Windows behaves, is not being submitted, and will be removed once the proper fix lands in Wine. It is there because it roughly triples upload throughput on high-latency connections. Use the stable tags unless upload speed is the reason you are here.

paths.name: Config
paths.description: Persistent storage for the Wine prefix and Backblaze configuration. Must survive container restarts.

paths.name: Backup Source (Drive D)
paths.description: Optional: map a host path to back up as drive D. Must be read-write: Backblaze creates a .bzvol folder in the drive's root to track and back it up. Repeat with /drive_e/, /drive_f/, etc. for additional locations.

ports.name: VNC Port
ports.description: Port for direct VNC client access.

variables.name: User ID
variables.description: UID the app runs as. On Unraid this is normally 99 (nobody), which matches user-share ownership - the app must own the files it backs up, since Backblaze writes a .bzvol folder into each drive's root. Change only if your data is owned by a different user (check with: id -u).

variables.name: Group ID
variables.description: GID the app runs as. On Unraid this is normally 100 (users), matching user-share ownership. Change only if your data is owned by a different group (check with: id -g).

variables.name: Force Latest Update
variables.description: When true (the default), the container downloads the newest Backblaze client on each start. Set to false to keep the installed client version and skip the update check.

variables.name: Enable Watchdog
variables.description: Set to true to let the container recover automatically when a backup stalls: it clears a stale four-hour lock left behind by an out-of-memory kill or an unclean restart, and restarts deadlocked upload threads. Actions are written to the container log. Off by default because it deletes a lock file and kills processes.

variables.name: Disable Auto-Update
variables.description: Set to true to skip the Backblaze version check on startup (faster boot, but won't auto-update).

variables.name: Disable Virtual Desktop
variables.description: Set to true to disable Wine's virtual desktop mode.
